title: Password Reset
description: Employees can reset their own password through the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.

title: VPN Access
description: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted through the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.

title: Laptop Replacement
description: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.

title: Software Installation Requests
description: Standard software listed in the approved catalog can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review. Security review takes 3–5 business days.
allowed_actions: Route non-catalog to IT Security review
approval_required: IT Security review for non-catalog software

title: Printer Troubleshooting
description: For printer issues: 1. Check the printer queue. 2. Restart the print spooler. 3. If the issue persists, log a ticket with the printer asset tag.
troubleshooting_steps: Log ticket with printer asset tag if issue persists

title: Email Mailbox Quota
description: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval. Maximum quota is 50GB.
approval_required: Manager approval required for quota increases beyond 25GB

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
description: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours. Any employee can generate credentials from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.

title: Expense Software Access
description: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login or technical issues once an account already exists.
it_scope: Login or technical assistance for existing accounts only

title: Security Incident Reporting
description: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported immediately to: security@veridian-corp.example. The suspected email or incident should NOT be forwarded to other employees.
prohibited_action: Do NOT forward to other employees

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
description: Employees working remotely more than 3 days per week are eligible for a one-time home-office equipment allowance for items such as chair or monitor. Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing. IT only handles equipment shipping after approval.
approval_required: Manager sign-off and Finance processing required before IT shipping

title: Asset Management Policy Extract
description: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from the date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
early_replacement_requirement: Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval
approval_required: Finance sign-off & IT approval for early replacement (<4 years)
